svg.title: 17 fractal resolution and escape
svg.desc: Finite-grid escape iteration maps from immutable Mandelbrot and Julia outputs. Logarithmic color records the first iteration whose modulus exceeds two. Navy regions identify points that did not escape within 160 iterations; these points are unresolved by this computation and are not certified members. The Julia parameter is c = −0.75 + 0.11i.
